description: React hook 'useWeather' that fetches weather data for a given city, managing load/error/data states with support for cancellation on city change.

methods.name: useWeather(city)
methods.description: Custom React hook to fetch weather data for a specified city, providing loading and error states with support for re-fetching.

methods.name: refetch
methods.description: Function to manually trigger refetch of weather data by aborting current fetch; relies on parent to change city to trigger useEffect.
